L: Excuse me. I booked a room with a sea view, but the room I was given faces the parking lot.
I'm very sorry about that. Let me ask my manager. Ms. Park, do we have any sea-view rooms left?
I'm afraid they're all taken tonight. But we can move you tomorrow morning, and tonight's dinner at our restaurant will be on us.
That sounds fair. What time can I move?
Any time after ten. I'll have someone carry your bags to the new room.

exq.q: What problem does the guest mention?
exq.a: Her room does not have the view she booked.
w: Her room is next to a noisy elevator.
Her bags were taken to the wrong floor.
Her booking was made for the wrong night.

exq.q: What will happen after ten o'clock?
w: The manager will call the guest.
